visi: To be an excellent and competitive study program in the field of Cybersecurity in Southeast Asia.

Conduct applied research based on partnerships with industry and society in Cybersecurity.
Carry out community empowerment activities in Cybersecurity.
Execute good and clean organizational governance.
tujuan: Produce competent, skilled, and certified graduates in Cybersecurity.
Generate research in partnership with industry and society in Cybersecurity.
Actively participate in raising public awareness of Cybersecurity.
Realize good and clean organizational governance aligned with international standards.
sasaran: Increase the quality and access to learning services in Cybersecurity.

program_educational_objectives.deskripsi: The Professional Self-Reliant Profile (PPM) of the D4 Cyber Security Engineering Study Program, targeted for graduates within 3 to 5 years after graduation, encompasses:
profil_profesional_mandiri: Graduates actively and innovatively contribute to identifying, analyzing, and solving complex cybersecurity challenges across global industries through ethical and state-of-the-art information technology.
Graduates continuously advance their cybersecurity expertise in technical, regulatory, and governance domains through applied research, professional community leadership, and lifelong learning.
Graduates creatively and professionally engineer cybersecurity solutions, products, and services tailored to evolving technological paradigms and global societal needs.

kompetensi_lulusan: Ability and skill to respond to organizational security threats effectively.
Ability to execute and report cybersecurity risk management implementation plans.
Ability to analyze internal and external network security threats and establish robust security policies.
Ability and skill to analyze and assess cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
Ability to design comprehensive cybersecurity risk awareness programs.
Ability to conduct systematic system vulnerability assessments within enterprise environments.
Ability to install and configure security mechanisms for institutional assets.
Ability to install and configure enterprise-scale network infrastructures.
Ability to install and configure computers, software applications, and network components.
capaian_pembelajaran_lulusan: Ability to identify and apply mathematics, natural sciences, computing, and engineering fundamentals appropriate to cybersecurity procedures, processes, and methodologies.
Ability to identify, formulate, research literature, and analyze broadly-defined engineering problems using validated analytical tools.
Ability to design systems, components, or processes meeting identified security needs considering health, safety, economic, societal, and environmental impacts.
Ability to investigate broadly-defined engineering problems using database code, literature research, and structured experiments.
Ability to select and utilize modern prediction tools, modeling, and IT resources to solve engineering problems.
Ability to consistently uphold professional ethics, national and international legal compliance, and embrace diversity and inclusion.
Ability to function effectively as an individual, team member, or leader in diverse, inclusive, and multidisciplinary environments.
Ability to communicate effectively in written, oral, and graphical formats across diverse technical and public communities.
Ability to apply engineering management principles to multidisciplinary projects as a member or leader.
Ability to engage in independent lifelong learning, critical thinking, and continuous professional development.

peluang_kerja_lulusan.deskripsi: Responsible for monitoring, detecting, and mitigating security threats in Security Operations Centers (SOC) and enforcing operational security procedures.
Executes cybersecurity controls and maintains compliance reporting according to enterprise risk management blueprints.
Analyzes perimeter and internal network threats, deploying firewalls, IDS/IPS, and enforcing network access control policies.
Performs security audits, vulnerability scanning, and vulnerability remediation testing across enterprise IT systems.
Manages cybersecurity governance, conducts risk assessments, and enforces security awareness programs.
Conducts security gap assessments and assists in hardening software and system architecture.
Maintains secure server operations, operating system hardening, patch management, and emergency troubleshooting.
Installs, configures, and supports LAN, WAN, router, switch, and cloud network infrastructure.
Deploys and maintains secure web servers, network applications, and end-user computing infrastructure.
